2026_04_MIA_MIN.headline: Miami searches for offensive traction against Minnesota after another uneven week
2026_04_MIA_MIN.paragraph1: Miami travels to Minnesota after a 24-10 loss to Kansas City in which the offense struggled to sustain production, putting added emphasis on quarterback efficiency and the run game at U.S. Bank Stadium. The Vikings can make that problem worse by creating pressure and forcing Miami into long-yardage situations. For the Dolphins, Malik Willis’ mobility offers a way to extend plays, but ball security and protection must improve. Minnesota’s offense can help its defense by controlling possession and avoiding short fields.
2026_04_MIA_MIN.model_rationale: Miami needs cleaner protection and sustained early-down production, while Minnesota can dictate the game by forcing long-yardage situations and controlling possession at home.
